scope: all subsets of the 11 nonboundary edges of each of TWO fixed k=3 witnesses; vertices retained

semantics.visible: single-edge deletion strictly enlarging Sigma; action label is target Sigma
semantics.weak_exit: zero or more silent steps, then one visible step
semantics.trace: finite Sigma sequence after collapsing adjacent repeats; all stopping prefixes
semantics.equivalence: divergence-insensitive weak bisimulation; edge identities and step counts hidden

factorization.high_order_predicate: boundary positions 0,1,2,3 do not use all four colors
factorization.formula: Sigma(M) = (Q if chord retained else FULL) intersect (H if all required edges retained else FULL)

runs.encoding: mask bit i means extra_edges[i] is retained; all five C5 edges always retained
